title: Quasi-coherent modules and maps extend across a quasi-compact open immersion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme whose inclusion $j:U\to X$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], i.e. $U\cap W$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] for every affine open $W\subseteq X$. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal M$ write $\mathcal M|_U$ for its restriction to $U$ ($\mathcal M|_U(W)=\mathcal M(W)$ for opens $W\subseteq U$). Let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $\mathcal G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module and let $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F|_U$ be an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map. Then there exist a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal H$, an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\psi:\mathcal H\to\mathcal F$ and an $\mathcal O_U$-linear isomorphism $\alpha:\mathcal H|_U\to\mathcal G$ such that $\varphi\circ\alpha=\psi|_U$.

proof.text: The inclusion j = U.ι is quasi-compact by hU. Mathlib supplies IsOpenImmersion j, its monomorphism and separatedness, and hence QuasiSeparated j. Set E = overEquiv U, L = restrictFunctor j, R = pushforward j, and A = restrictAdjunction j. The private proved helper overEquiv_quasiCoherent transports quasi-coherence of G along E using SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint and continuity on the iterated over sites.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PE (lemma-extend-trivial), part (3), lines 2787-2836 with its proof ($\mathcal H=\Ker(\mathcal F\oplus j_*\mathcal G\to j_*j^*\mathcal F)$)

proof.text: Set G′ = E.functor.obj G and φ′ = E.functor.map φ followed by (overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app F. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence by Mathlib isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor. The two modules R(G′) and R(L(F)) are quasi-coherent by pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh. Define a = A.unit.app F and b = R.map φ′. Take the actual categorical pullback H = pullback a b and ψ = pullback.fst a b; no arbitrary witness of an existence theorem is selected.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PE (lemma-extend-trivial), part (3), lines 2787-2836 with its proof ($\mathcal H=\Ker(\mathcal F\oplus j_*\mathcal G\to j_*j^*\mathcal F)$)

proof.text: The private proved helper quasiCoherent_pullback identifies pullback a b with kernel (biprod.desc a (-b)) using Mathlib Abelian.PullbackToBiproductIsKernel.isLimitPullbackToBiproduct. The biproduct is quasi-coherent by isQuasicoherent_biprod, its kernel is quasi-coherent by isQuasicoherent_kernel, and quasi-coherence transports along the resulting isomorphism. This is exactly the source construction Ker(F ⊕ j_*G → j_*j^*F), up to its canonical isomorphism.

proof.text: Restriction L preserves limits by the source-library preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor. The counit of A is an isomorphism for an open immersion. The left triangle identity makes L.map a its inverse. Thus the second projection of the restricted pullback is an isomorphism. Compose PreservesPullback.iso L a b, that second projection, and the counit at G′ to obtain e : L(H) ≅ G′. Pullback commutativity, counit naturality, and the triangle identity prove L.map ψ = e.hom ≫ φ′. Use the fully faithful E.functor to take the preimage isomorphism α : H.over U ≅ G of (overFunctorEquiv U).app H ≪≫ e. Apply E.functor.map_injective; naturality of overFunctorEquiv U and cancellation of its component at F give overFunctor.map ψ = α.hom ≫ φ. These steps are written out in Lean, without any additional assumed statement.
